text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Having lunch with City-san♪ 
#GorgeousCity-san #and #CuteCurrenChan"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Umastagram upload complete♪ I'm sure it'll 
get lots of "Umalikes"☆

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Geez, Curren's so good at sweeping people 
along at her own pace. Before I knew it, 
we'd had lunch and taken photos together.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Because I wanted to be with you, City-san. 
Did you not want to...?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"...Sigh. This is why I hate dealing with 
this."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Whoa, already 50k Umalikes? That's 
crazy fast.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, are you watching~? The comments came 
in right away—all thanks to the great 
City-san♪

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
It's true, the comments just keep 
coming... "Cute," "Beautiful," "A 
collision of beauty"—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Haaah!? What is this?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: What's the matter~?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Ah, no...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ...Ummm, what's this~?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Normies shouldn't be hanging around 
City-san." "Know your place." ...Oh, my.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Oh boy, hate comments. I guess they were 
bound to show up~.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Still, using my name to put down Curren is 
totally uncalled for. Even if they're my 
fan, I won't ever forgive that...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Now, now. Something like this doesn't 
phase Curren at all, or rather—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ah... But since coming to Tracen Academy, 
maybe the hate comments have gone up a 
tiny bit?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Huh, seriously?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
It feels about right for the follower 
increase. But I've been a little concerned 
about the comments section getting 
toxic~... Hmm.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey, hey. How would you handle this, 
Onii-chan?"
choice_data_list:
We'll handle it according to the 
guidelines.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey, hey. How would you handle this, 
Onee-chan?"
choice_data_list:
We'll handle it according to the 
guidelines.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Yeah, you're right. If it's 
Curren, she would.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Hm? What's that? I don't get it at all.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"It means you were thinking the exact same 
thing as Curren, Big Brother♪"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
It means you were thinking the exact same 
thing as Curren, Big Sis♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
So with that said! City, we'd love your 
help too~♪

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Yes?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The next day—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, there you are, City-san! Thanks for 
yesterday♪

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"...I was just looking at your Umastagram. 
And I finally get what you meant by 
'leading through cuteness.'"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Aha, could you tell? It's all thanks to 
City-san, you know.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
City-san taught Curren a different way to 
take photos, and the comment section 
became so much nicer♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that, Curren Chan posted new photos 
that pushed the limits of cute even 
further. Seeing her reach a level one step 
above before, everyone――

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"She's no normie, she's an angel, so 
cute." ...is what it says. What a total 
180.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
No, it's not? That person simply realized 
Curren's cuteness, that's all♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Curren is super happy to get more 
followers too~♪ If you ever need any help, 
City-san, Curren will gladly lend a hand, 
okay?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"No, normal people can't pull this off. 
You really are something else..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Watching Gold City look at the cheerful 
Curren Chan with eyes of subtle awe, I 
secretly found myself sympathizing with 
her...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, well, that's normally how it goes, 
but... Could it be that Big Bro is a 
little mad?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, well, that's normally how it goes, 
but... Could it be that Big Sis is a 
little mad?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Even if she says she's fine, I can't turn 
a blind eye to actions that hurt my 
trainee Umamusume. So, I told her we 
should deal with it swiftly."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I agree. Things like this don't get better 
if you just leave them alone.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Let's report it to Umastagram. It might 
take a bit, but they'll probably handle 
it.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you very much, both of you♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Still, Curren has a little hunch. So 
please keep watching over me just a bit 
longer♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A few days later—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad the matter was resolved, but... 
to think you'd leave it in the hands of 
your followers.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
No, no, Curren didn't assign anything! 
Everyone just thought for themselves and 
did what they felt needed doing♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Yes, after fans spotted the slanderous 
comment and earnestly shared Curren Chan's 
charms... the commenter voluntarily 
deleted it."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
“Still, I was surprised they even backed 
me up. It's all thanks to everyone♪”

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Talk about walking a tightrope, though. If 
you'd slandered them instead, you could've 
ended up getting lynched online.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Ah, that's not it at all.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Because someone who loves Curren would 
never do anything un-cute♪"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...I see. So you've built quite a good 
relationship, then.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"Maybe I'll go check out the comments too. 
Maybe I'll leave an 'Uma-zing' like for 
once..."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey, Onii-chan. You don't actually 
agree with Curren's way of doing things, 
do you?"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey, Onee-chan. You don't actually 
agree with Curren's way of doing things, 
do you?"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Sorry for worrying you, okay? It went 
well, though, and besides—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
You standing up for me like that was 
suuuper... cool, big bro. Thanks a bunch♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
You standing up for me like that was 
suuuper... cool, big sis. Thanks a bunch♪
